description:
*** SUPERSEDED BY: unified-platform-comparison-cli.yaml ***

This TODO was superseded by a unified approach that avoids CLI bloat.
Instead of adding a separate `compare-sql` command, we will:
- Extend existing `benchbox compare` command with --run mode
- Support both SQL and DataFrame via --type flag
- Share visualization and reporting code

New CLI pattern:
- benchbox compare results/*.json              # Existing: compare files
- benchbox compare --run -p duckdb -p sqlite   # NEW: run & compare

See: _project/TODO/platform-comparison/planning/unified-platform-comparison-cli.yaml

Original problem (still valid):
- MISSING: CLI command to RUN benchmarks across SQL platforms
- MISSING: Visualization integration for SQL comparison charts
- MISSING: User-friendly documentation for SQL comparison

These will be addressed in the unified TODO.
